generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: Cross-service writes must be retry-safe. At-least-once consumers check ledger/event identity and aggregate revision, record duplicate outcome and do not reapply mutation; delayed events are safe without cross-partition order reliance. Rejected stale/unauthorized writes leave business state unchanged before the relevant event publication. Accepted transitions require one audit record and tenant-scoped traces; diagnostic telemetry excludes source text. generated_evidence.normalized_proposition_en: Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes;
generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish. Approval binds exactly reviewed content. Final-response pointer and satisfied gate commit atomically; replay cannot publish another artifact under old approval. Recompute authorization at publication after intervening tenant/document permission changes; reject stale evidence even after successful search/review. Publication invoker, endpoint/button, exact status mapping and recovery are open. [Source: pp.7,11–12,45–46,59; `screen_functions:r1:c4:f3`, `screen_functions:r1:c11:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c13:f4`, `screen_functions:r1:c74:f1`, `screen_functions:r1:c76:f2`, `screen_functions:r1:c100:f2`]

pdf_evidence.quote_en: At the interface boundary, EdgeGateway records shall carry tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and a correlation ID wherever the operation changes durable state. The request path POST /v1/runs must validate input before allocating a long-running operation; if a dependency is unavailable, callers receive a documented retryable error or a persisted asynchronous job identifier, never an ambiguous success.

generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Confirmed.** Public REST uses `/v1` resource nouns, cursor pagination and RFC3339 timestamps. External OpenAPI and internal protobuf are generated from repository-controlled IDL and govern their respective clients/messages. Internal HTTP/RPC is versioned/generated/independently authorized. CI prevents breaking field deletion and incompatible enum changes. Nonbreaking evolution is additive; removal requires a scheduled migration. No actual repository, migration date, enum extension policy or REST unknown-field rule is supplied. Model-output unknown-field rejection must not be applied universally to REST requests without confirmation. heading_context: SF-010 — SCR-005 Review Inbox and publication
generated_evidence.full_physical_line_en: **Publication is distinct from approval.** Required evidence and satisfied versioned deterministic policy are prerequisites; unapproved high-risk runs cannot publish.
